honesty_boundary: This is a finite spectral-action/heat-kernel layer for the RG spinor.  It is not yet the continuum spectral action of a physical Dirac operator on spacetime.
theorem: The finite RG spinor generator has spectrum {+sqrt(5049)/2,-sqrt(5049)/2}. Therefore det(sI-G)=s^2-5049/4, tr((sI-G)^-1)=2s/(s^2-5049/4), tr(exp(tG))=2cosh(sqrt(5049)t/2), and tr(exp(-tau G^2))=2exp(-(5049/4)tau).
title: Finite Spectral Action / Heat Kernel Compiler
